scripts.browser:chrome: node -e "const { exec } = require('child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'start chrome http://localhost:8080/' : 'google-chrome http://localhost:8080/'; exec(cmd);"
scripts.browser:edge: node -e "const { exec } = require('child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'start msedge http://localhost:8080/' : 'microsoft-edge http://localhost:8080/'; exec(cmd);"
scripts.browser:firefox: node -e "const { exec } = require('child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'start firefox http://localhost:8080/' : 'firefox http://localhost:8080/'; exec(cmd);"
scripts.browser:safari: node -e "const { exec } = require('child_process'); exec('open -a Safari http://localhost:8080/');"
